summary: FEAT-003 meets design 5.1/5.3/5.4 and OD5/OD6: LinearPipeline emits unwarped uint8 labels after T[, Rt] via an aligned epoch reader (same paired permutation and seed), the data module resolves synth label files eagerly and leaves the default call unchanged, five --synth-* flags validate as specified and synth_config_from_args returns None at p 0, Trainer routes every post-process call through _pp_call with keyword-only labels and positional skip in the four new lambdas (off lambdas/signatures unchanged), logs synth_frac/loss_synth/loss_real, checkpoints postprocess_<t>_synth only when on, BN recal uses deterministic synthetic slots, and main.py writes/guards the synth record only when on. Recorded evidence: 173 + 74 + 52 tests OK, both goldens max |diff| 0, cascade-skip guard bodies unchanged, trace counts 1 per task, OneHot depths on == off, py3.8/TF-free checks OK. NITs: linear DALI label reader not executed locally (add an alignment check in FEAT-004 verify), duplicate import line in test_cascade, duplicated LinearPipeline call branch in data_module.
